body:
New research project `research/freivalds-float` (stdlib Python, 7 tests, experiments, white paper), plus README and portfolio page entries.

- Rank-one corruption of Frobenius norm F is missed by a Gaussian probe with probability exactly erf(t/(√2F)); rank one is the worst case for fixed F (simulation)
- m probes give erf^m; closed-form probe counts (4 probes for 1% at F=3t)
- Rademacher probes miss a two-entry corruption with probability exactly ½ at every size
- Emulated float32 noise floor grows ≈ n^0.9; tolerance sets the hidden-deviation budget
- Probe hashed from the result with free retries: 1/erf grinding tries
